about: The models of the Anatomy tab, converted from Z-Anatomy (build/anatomy). Coordinates in metres, Y up, the body facing +Z; the patient's left is +X.

credit.models: Z-Anatomy – the libre 3D atlas of anatomy, by Gauthier Kervyn and others (CC BY-SA 4.0), largely made from BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science (CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan); the brain's surface from "Brain for Blender" by Anderson M. Winkler (CC BY-SA 3.0); the cranial nerves after "Cranial Nerves and Foramina", University of Dundee, CAHID (CC BY 4.0). Simplified and converted for the BMS workbench (CC BY-SA 4.0).
credit.definitions: The definitions are the opening sentences of Wikipedia's articles (CC BY-SA), as kept in Z-Anatomy; each links to its article.
